comment: Per-directory deletion rules for archive_rotate.py --retention (see docs/research_lab/data_catalogue/RETENTION.md). A server file is only ever removed if it is in a verified release with an identical sha256; these rules only say how old it must be and which small files stay. Directories without a rule are never deleted. GATE (2026-10-17): snapshots/ and book_sweeps/ stay in deferred_rules. snapshots/ moves to rules only when backend/scripts/retention_gate_check.py prints retention_gate PASS on the host (CB1/CB2/CB3/CB4 extract manifests complete; CB4 needed the closewin pass step). book_sweeps/ stays deferred until q0035 (J4-R) is done and the MC1 q0111 panel is cached. cb1_extract/, cb2_extract/, cb3_extract/, cb4_extract/ are never deleted (no rule).
